links.outcome: Clinical sign-out time with versus without AI-generated preliminary sign-outs in the workflow
links.effect: Sign-out time fell by 28.5 seconds per case (23% efficiency gain), and by 65 seconds per case (51%) with a second non-AI workflow improvement. Overreliance was not assessed.
links.quote: Workflow integration of the AI tool reduced clinical sign-out times by 28.5 seconds per case (23% efficiency gain), and by 65 seconds per case (51% efficiency gain) when integrated alongside a second, non-AI workflow improvement.

unlisted_practices: Using LLMs to extract structured labels from historical free-text interpretations to train a predictive model

screen.reason: The study evaluates the actual deployment and clinical workflow integration of an AI/LLM system generating preliminary urine drug test sign-out statements, measuring impact on sign-out times and user experience.

primary.practice: workflow integration for preliminary clinical sign-out with clinician review
